_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. Reconstructed from prior session summaries — features marked 'passing' below reflect what was REPORTED complete, not a command that was just re-run. Re-verify each with verification.md before trusting the 'passing' label, per Principle 9/10.

features.name: Node CRUD
features.behavior: Create/read/update/delete an idea Node (title, content, tags, status, importance weight) via REST
features.evidence: pytest passed; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Edge CRUD with typed relations
features.behavior: Create/read/update/delete an Edge between two Nodes with a relation type (e.g. leads_to, resolves, extends, contradicts)
features.evidence: pytest passed; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Text embedding pipeline
features.behavior: Node content is converted to a semantic text embedding via a Transformer model
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_embedding.py -x passed 3/3 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Graph-aware node embeddings (GNN)
features.behavior: Text embeddings combined with the adjacency matrix through a GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE layer to produce graph-aware node embeddings
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_gnn*.py passed 9/9 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Link prediction / smart link suggestions
features.behavior: Endpoint returns unconnected node pairs with a similarity score >= threshold as suggested links
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_link*.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Community detection / clustering
features.behavior: Nodes are grouped into color-coded clusters ('mind regions') based on graph + semantic similarity
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_cluster*.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Graph topology analytics
features.behavior: Compute degree centrality, betweenness centrality, and PageRank per node
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_topology.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Semantic + topological search
features.behavior: Search endpoint supports keyword search combined with sub-graph / breadth-first expansion from a seed node
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_search*.py passed 9/9 tests; 107 full suite passed
